column1: # Bank 32: equip screen stat block. GRID layout (gfx_labels.GRID): piece col row rows jp en.
# Piece 0 = 64x64 (金 .. 両 in col 0, the five stats in cols 2-6); piece 1 = 32x64 (次の段まで col 0, 段 col 1).
# Columns are x = 5 + 8 * col; row 0 and row 62 are the frame lines.
# Values (kanji digits, drawn by other OBJs) end at row 63 and take 8 rows per digit: a 3-digit stat starts at
# row 39, so stat labels end by row 37; the gold value can reach row 15 with 5 digits.
# 防御 = GUARD (the B-button move is "Guard"; DEFENSE needs 41 rows). 段 (col 1) is a guess: "LV".
